leadText:
Surf's Up, Pikachu issue 2 is the fourteenth monthly issue of the manga series The Electric Tale of Pikachu to be released by VIZ Media. It contains the sixteenth chapter of the manga, as well as some bonus content that was not in the original volume.

The contents of this issue were later rereleased by VIZ Media as part of .

==Publications==
 
 

==Chapters==
You Bet Your Wife

==Important events==
Ash meets up with Misty again and meets Rudy and Mahri.
Ash challenges the Trovita Gym and wins. 
Rudy begins crossdressing so that his little sister can have an older sister.
